title.en: Strategy Lab: compare your own backtest
title.zh: 策略实验室：把你自己的回测拿来比一比

details.en: Upload an equity curve (CSV) or a MetaTrader strategy tester report and see where it ranks against every arena strategy on the same market and the same trading days. Everything is computed in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
details.zh: 上传权益曲线（CSV）或 MetaTrader 策略测试报告，看看它在同一市场、同样的交易日里，和竞技场每个策略相比排在哪里。所有计算都在你的浏览器里完成，文件不会上传。

title.en: Crisis tests, luck-adjusted Sharpe and embeddable badges
title.zh: 大跌测试、扣除运气的夏普与可嵌入徽章

details.en: Strategy pages now show how each strategy did in the Q4 2018 sell-off, the COVID crash and the 2022 bear market, its returns above and below the 200-day average, CAGR after 10 bp trading costs, and the Deflated Sharpe Ratio, which corrects for testing many strategies at once. Each strategy also has a live Arena Score badge you can embed.
details.zh: 策略页新增：在 2018 年四季度下跌、新冠暴跌和 2022 年熊市中的表现，市场在 200 日均线上方和下方时的收益，扣除 10 bp 交易成本后的年化收益，以及修正“同时测试很多策略”偏差的 Deflated 夏普。每个策略还有可以嵌入的实时 Arena Score 徽章。

title.en: Chinese strategy pages and share images

details.en: All 72 strategy pages and the category pages now have Chinese versions, and every strategy has a share image with its equity curve and key numbers for social media previews.
details.zh: 72 个策略页和分类页都有了中文版；每个策略还配了分享图，带权益曲线和关键数字，分享到社交平台时会显示预览卡片。

title.en: Today's signals, strategy heatmap, weekly reports and RSS
title.zh: 今日信号、策略热力图、每周报告与 RSS

details.en: New pages show the current position of every strategy on every market, an Arena Score heatmap of strategies × markets, and an automatic weekly report (market moves, signal changes, best and worst strategies). Follow along with the RSS feed at /feed.xml (Chinese: /zh/feed.xml).
details.zh: 新增页面：每个策略在每个市场的当前持仓、策略 × 市场的 Arena Score 热力图，以及自动生成的每周报告（市场涨跌、信号变化、表现最好和最差的策略）。可以通过 RSS 订阅：/feed.xml（中文版 /zh/feed.xml）。

title.en: Arena Score v2 and 20 new metrics
title.zh: Arena Score 第二版与 20 项新指标

details.en: The Arena Score now ranks each strategy against the others on the same market and window across five components (return quality, drawdown control, consistency, robustness, significance), so the leaderboard no longer has blocks of ties at 100 or 0, and strategies that were almost never in the market are not ranked. Strategy pages add time in market, Ulcer index, longest drawdown, VaR/CVaR, alpha, beta, capture ratios and the probabilistic Sharpe ratio, with five new glossary entries.
details.zh: Arena Score 改为在同一品种、同一窗口内，按五个分项（收益质量、回撤控制、稳定性、稳健性、统计可信度）和其他策略比较打分，排行榜不再出现大片 100 分或 0 分的并列，几乎不持仓的策略也不再参与排名。策略页新增持仓时间、Ulcer 指数、最长回撤、VaR/CVaR、Alpha、Beta、捕获率和概率夏普等指标，词典也新增了 5 个词条。

title.en: Every strategy, article and EA now has its own page
title.zh: 每个策略、文章和 EA 都有了独立页面

details.en: 72 strategy pages with equity curves, results on every market and a buy-and-hold comparison; strategy category hubs; research articles in English and Chinese; a 12-term metrics glossary with live examples; and 1,515 EA pages in both languages. Pages load fast and can be found by search engines.
details.zh: 72 个策略页（含权益曲线、各市场结果、与买入持有的对比）、策略分类页、中英文研究文章、12 个指标词条（附排行榜真实例子），以及 1515 个中英文 EA 页面。页面加载快，也更容易被搜索引擎找到。

title.en: EA rankings now only use reliable backtests
title.zh: EA 排行榜只统计有效回测

details.en: Sharpe ratios are recomputed from each equity curve (the old values used yearly returns and were often meaningless). Results with no trades, run errors or flat curves are labelled and left out of the ranking, and detail pages say why.
details.zh: 夏普比率改为按每条权益曲线重新计算（旧数值按年度收益计算，很多没有意义）。零交易、运行报错或曲线持平的结果会被标注并排除在排名之外，详情页也会说明原因。

details.en: Press / or Ctrl/Cmd+K anywhere to search strategies, EAs, research notes and pages. The home page now remembers what you opened recently (stored only in your browser).
details.zh: 在任意页面按 / 或 Ctrl/Cmd+K，就能搜索策略、EA、研究文章和页面。首页会记住你最近看过的内容（只保存在你自己的浏览器里）。

title.en: Redesigned header, home page and footer
title.zh: 导航、首页和页脚全新改版

details.en: A cleaner navigation with a More menu, icon theme and language toggles, a new home overview with live counts, quick-entry cards, ranked top strategies, a timeline changelog, back-to-top button and a reading progress bar on articles.
details.zh: 导航更简洁，次要页面收进“更多”菜单，主题和语言切换改成图标按钮。首页新增平台概览、快捷入口和带分数的策略排行；更新日志改成时间线；文章页加了阅读进度条，长页面有回到顶部按钮。

title.en: Faster loading and real backtest data restored
title.zh: 加载提速，恢复真实回测数据

details.en: Equity curves are now split per instrument and loaded on demand, and EA analysis data only loads on EA pages, cutting the initial download from tens of MB to about 3 MB. The last complete backtest snapshot (2026-08-17) is back in place of placeholder figures, and pages show the data date clearly.
details.zh: 净值曲线按品种拆分、按需加载，EA 分析数据只在 EA 页面才下载，首次打开的数据量从几十 MB 降到 3MB 左右。同时恢复了最近一次完整的回测数据（2026-08-17），不再显示占位数字，页面上也会标明数据日期。

entries.title: Backtest Pipeline Complete: 560 Strategies Tested
entries.details: All 560 auto-convertible EA strategies have been backtested on EURUSD H1 data (730 days) using backtrader. Results include total trades, win rate, P&L, max drawdown, and equity curves for each EA.

entries.title: Equity Curve Visualization
entries.details: EA detail pages now display an equity curve chart rendered with Canvas API. Charts show ~200 downsampled points with gradient fill and theme-aware styling.

entries.title: Markdown Rendering for EA Analysis
entries.details: EA analysis and description fields now render Markdown syntax (headings, lists, code blocks, bold/italic) using marked.js v15.0.12. Both Chinese and English views support full Markdown.

entries.title: Backtest Result Auto-Sync
entries.details: Added sync_backtest_to_site.py to automate the full cycle: generate strategy → run backtest → update index → publish site → push to repo.

entries.title: Generator Overhaul: Sub-Line + Level Reference Resolution
entries.details: MQ5→Python generator now resolves Bollinger Band sub-lines (.lines.bot/.top/.mid), Ichimoku sub-lines (.l.tenkan/.l.kijun/.l.senkou_span_a/.l.senkou_span_b), and 30+ level reference patterns (oversold, overbought, ADX threshold, etc.). Same-base crossover guard prevents CrossOver(close, close) false signals.

entries.title: EA Comparison Feature
entries.details: EA Arena now supports side-by-side comparison of up to 4 EAs. Select via checkboxes, compare metrics in a modal overlay, and share comparisons via URL parameters.

entries.title: MQ5→Python Backtest Pipeline
entries.details: Implemented Scheme 2 pipeline: LLM-assisted MQ5→structured JSON→Python backtrader template. Includes extract_logic.py (GLM-5.1 analysis), generate_backtrader.py (template codegen), and run_backtest.py (execution with progress tracking).
